findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mx_rfc, mx_curp, mx_clabe · Private data: json_diff, json_patch, pdf_tables · Public sink: validate_json, csv_to_json, json_diff, json_patch, pdf_text, pdf_tables, mx_rfc, mx_curp, mx_clabe · Destructive: mx_rfc, mx_curp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mx_rfc, mx_curp, mx_clabe · Private data: json_diff, json_patch, pdf_tables · Public sink: validate_json, csv_to_json, json_diff, json_patch, pdf_text, pdf_tables, mx_rfc, mx_curp, mx_clabe · Destructive: mx_rfc, mx_curp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
